name: Controlled Scale and Multisite Expansion
purpose: Define a controlled, evidence-inheriting framework for expansion from the reference Lagos proof pilot to additional authorized physical sites and international administrative grids without transferring unsupported evidence values.
principles: reference-pilot evidence semantics are inherited, not evidence values
administrative nodes remain distinct from physical field sites
each physical site requires local authorization and readiness
each batch and evidence package retains site-specific identity
new geography enters through controlled replication gates
material deviations trigger HOLD rather than silent normalization
replication_controls: local QMS and regulatory pathway confirmation
independent assurance sampling across the expanded scope
fail_closed_conditions: coordinates unverified for a physical site
evidence from another site reused as if locally observed
permissible_claims: a site is onboarded to the controlled expansion framework
a defined site completed a controlled pilot
evidence semantics are replicated across sites
multisite operation is authorized for a defined scope
prohibited_claims: multisite framework proves all sites are operational
